<dd><p>Structured Documentledger error with a machine-readable code.</p>
<p>This is a plain exception on purpose: the CLI layer owns error rendering so
that command names and JSON-vs-human output stay consistent. It does not
subclass <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">click.ClickException</span></code> because Click would intercept it and
bypass that control.</p>
